description: This file declares classes and methods related to Virtual Socket (Vsock) connections, including client and server implementations, within the Cuttlefish project's common library. It provides interface definitions, connection management, and read/write functionalities for Vsock communication.

classes.name: VsockConnection
classes.description: Abstract base class providing interface for Vsock connection operations, including connect, disconnect, read, write, and message handling.

classes.name: VsockClientConnection
classes.description: Derived class implementing client-side Vsock connection logic.

classes.name: VsockServerConnection
classes.description: Derived class implementing server-side Vsock connection logic, including server shutdown.

methods.name: ~VsockConnection
methods.description: Virtual destructor for VsockConnection base class.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a Vsock connection to a specified port and CID, optionally with a vhost user CID.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Closes the Vsock connection.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously initiates a connection to a specified port and CID.

methods.name: SetDisconnectCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to be invoked upon disconnection.

methods.name: IsConnected_Unguarded
methods.description: Checks if the connection is active without thread-safety guarantees.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection is active, thread-safe.

methods.name: DataAvailable
methods.description: Checks if data is available to read.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a single 32-bit integer from the connection.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into a provided buffer.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes into a vector.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a specified number of bytes into a vector.

methods.name: ReadMessage
methods.description: Reads a message into a provided vector.

methods.name: ReadMessage
methods.description: Reads a message and returns it as a vector.

methods.name: ReadMessageAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a message.

methods.name: ReadJsonMessage
methods.description: Reads a JSON message and parses it into a Json::Value.

methods.name: ReadJsonMessageAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads and parses a JSON message.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit integer to the connection.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes raw data to the connection.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data from a vector to the connection.

methods.name: WriteMessage
methods.description: Sends a string message.

methods.name: WriteMessage
methods.description: Sends data from a vector as a message.

methods.name: WriteMessage
methods.description: Sends a JSON message.

methods.name: WriteStrides
methods.description: Writes data with specified stride configuration.

methods.name: ServerShutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the server connection.
